subject: Engineering Physics

questions.markdown: What is attenuation in an optical fiber? What are the different types of attenuation processes in optical fiber?
The ratio of population of atoms between upper state to ground state atoms is $1.059\times 10^{-30}$. Find the wavelength of the light emitted at 300 K.
Why is the pumping system important to obtain a laser?
What is phase speed and group speed for a quantum particle. Derive a relation between phase speed and group speed.
A blackbody at 7500 K consists of an opening of diameter 0.05 mm, looking into an oven. Find the number of photons per second escaping the hole and having wavelengths between 500 nm and 501 nm.

Sketch schematically the graph of intensity of radiation vs wavelength from a blackbody, at two different temperatures (two graphs with the same scale).

Find the peak wavelength of the Sun with a surface temperature of 5800 K. Wien's constant is $2.898\times 10^{-3}\,\text{m.K}$.
Derive an expression for density-of-states function for an electron in a metal.

A quantum simple harmonic oscillator consists of an electron bound by a restoring force proportional to its position relative to certain equilibrium points. The proportionality constant is k = 9.1 N/m. What is the wavelength of light emitted if the harmonic oscillator de-excites from the second excited state to the first excited state.
When an electron and a proton of the same kinetic energy encounter a potential barrier of the same height and width, which one of them will tunnel through the barrier more easily? Why?
Describe two main characteristics of ferroelectric substances. Sketch the polarization versus electric field curve and show the saturation and remanent polarization points.

Calculate the induced dipole moment per unit volume (i.e., polarization) of the helium gas when placed in an electric field of $6\times 10^{5}\,\text{V/m}$. The polarizability of helium is $0.18\times 10^{-40}\,\text{Fm}^2$ and the concentration of helium atoms is $2.6\times 10^{25}\,/\text{m}^3$. Also, calculate the separation of positive and negative charges in each atom.
Electrons are not charge carriers in superconductors. Justify the statement.
Discuss the properties and applications of metallic glasses.

An HCl molecule is excited to its first rotational energy level, corresponding to $J = 1$. If the distance between its nuclei is $r_0 = 0.1275\,\text{nm}$, what is the angular speed of the molecule about its centre of mass ?

Given: Mass (in atomic mass unit) of H is 1 amu and Cl is 35 amu. Take 1 amu as $1.66\times 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$.
How does the uncertainty principle explain why it's impossible to know both the exact position and exact momentum of a particle simultaneously?
